name: Fixes reach prod
ownerWords: 이런 느낌으로 푸쉬해줘. 모든 쓰레드에서 user intent를 분석하고, 꾸준히 발생했던 문제는 duties로 묶어야 돼.
goal: Every fix that lands on staging is ready for prod: the gates in front of the owner's release walk stay green. Prod is auto-sns-agent main, which promote.yml moves only after every prod deploy and check passes, so a commit on staging and not on main has not fully reached prod even when the prod crawler already runs it. Under owner rule c154 (2026-10-22) a job's work ends at staging, and every prod promote is a walk with the owner that only the release owner (session 01a10810) dispatches, except the crawler, observability dashboards and demo.virev.ai. So this duty keeps the gates in front of that walk green, which are the land into staging, the staging deploy of staging's head, the full verify of staging's head and the promote itself, and tells the release owner what waits once they are. The problem kept coming back in this chat: promotes 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 and 14 each failed at a gate, 18 lands named a failure between 10-08 and 10-19, on 10-19 seven board steps waited a day or more for one promote while land 37 sat on staging from 10-17 22:58Z, and from 10-23 00:41Z every land failed at basics while the staging deploy of staging's head 6e71eb0478 had failed, which the precheck missed because 53 of the newest 60 land runs were cancelled. Each run names the oldest waiting commit, the newest decided land of each branch, the newest successful land and staging head's age, the newest decided staging deploy and the newest staging sha whose staging deploy passed, whether staging's head is promotable, the newest finished full verify with its red jobs, the newest decided promote, each failed run's job and step, and where the staging and prod crawlers' /health versions sit. promote.yml ships only staging's head and needs both its deploy/staging status and its full verify, the verify-dev probe run staging-check.yml dispatches, green, so a passed staging deploy alone is not release clearance; on 10-24 the release owner corrected the runs' "every gate is green" twice, at 01:44Z and about 07:00Z, because they read staging_deploy_passed on 3b0fcfee0b as clearance while its full verify, run 40067724892, had failed. The 8 in commits_on_staging_only is the busiest UTC day of staging lands from 10-01 to 10-19 (8 lands on 10-19), so more than that waiting means at least a day of lands missed prod. Since 10-23 oldest_fix_wait_h and commits_on_staging_only are readings with no target: under c154 only the release owner's walks with the owner move prod, so no job can shorten how long a fix waits for prod, and with the 24 h target this duty went red at 03:50Z on 10-23 at 24.5 h with every gate green, the way Vent integrations' prod_vent_behind_staging_h did until 284a6412.

onMiss: Read the gate flags first. A red gate is a land_failed run, a staging_deploy_failed run of staging's head, a no_promotable_staging_sha flag whose newest finished full verify ended failure (its red jobs are named in the flag), or a promote_failed run. Each red gate gets exactly one fix job, with a board step under p96 whose text starts "d4/<metric key>:" and names that gate's run id, job, step and hours from the flag. When a live job of any chat already owns that gate (await agent_observe.list_agents()), send it the run id, job, step and hours by message and set the step's job to it; else start one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd=...) and set the step's job to it, never a second copy. The fix is shipped code that makes that gate pass on its own (the check, the deploy config or the test it names), landed on staging through land.yml. A promote_in_flight, staging_deploy_in_flight or full_verify_in_flight flag means that run is going: set board.wake(run=<id>) and read its result after the wake instead of starting a job for the same gate. oldest_fix_wait_h and commits_on_staging_only are readings and never a miss: when the run flags promotable and oldest_fix_wait_h reads over 24 h, the wait is the owner's release walk (c154), so message the release owner (session 01a10810) once with the sha from promotable, the oldest_fix commit and the hours it waited, and start no code job or fix step for it. staging_deploy_passed says only that a staging deploy passed and is never release clearance: no run, check-in or message calls a sha ready to promote or says every gate is green unless the run flags promotable, and when it flags no_promotable_staging_sha, a report says no staging sha is promotable and names that flag's full verify run, its conclusion and its red jobs. A source_error is fixed in this precheck first. Never dispatch, rerun or cancel a land.yml, staging-deploy.yml or promote.yml run, and touch no prod state. Nothing goes outside (c37). All on target: end the turn with no message.
